messages:
Sam: Heads-up: planning to roll the new circuit-breaker thresholds flag (cb-threshold-v2) tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Main goal: reduce noisy fallbacks to smaller models during short bursts. Need quick ack on smoke checks + rollback plan.
Anya: Plan: canary 5% for 1h -> 25% for 2h -> 100%. Defaults conservative: threshold=0.6, max-consecutive-failures=3. Will enable automated rollback if error-rate > 2% over 5m.
Liam: who will kick the deploy? I can trigger if infra confirms capacity. Also can run the smoke script: `scripts/smoke/cb_smoke.sh`.
Ben: confirm toggling the flag is atomic per-region? we should avoid mid-rollout region mismatch. Also agree we need a kill switch: `cb.disable_all=true`.
Katie: I can take the 09:30 slot and run the canary. I'll run perf + latency dashboards during windows — which dashboards should I watch?
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout created by @Katie: start=2026-03-18T09:30:00Z steps=[5%,25%,100%]. Notifying oncall.
ops-oncall: noted. pls update runbook with rollback command and the exact metrics to monitor. Recommend `error_rate`, `p95_latency`, `fallback_rate`.
Anya: Adding rollback command to runbook: `redwoodctl feature rollback cb-threshold-v2 --immediate`. Also adding smoke checks snippet:
```
# smoke checks
./scripts/smoke/cb_smoke.sh --checks error_rate,p95_latency,fallback_rate
```
Sam: Nice. Ben — can you own the rollback watch (monitor 15m) in case we see >2% errors? Katie will coordinate deploy. Liam pls stand by to assist with capacity.
Ben: Yep, I'll monitor. If I see rising errors I'll flip `cb.disable_all=true` and ping #incidents.
Katie: I'll run the canary and post results here after the first 5% window — will include perf graphs and smoke script output. cc @ops-oncall @Ben
Sam: :thumbsup: thanks all, I'll update the deploy doc with these notes.
